text: {sw.heard[2].figure} or {sw.heard[1].figure} a year: that's what the stormwater program would cost a typical single-family home in Lunenburg under the two options, as presented. On {tm.date|day}, Town Meeting gets an advisory vote on which way to go: a new stormwater fee, or the regular budget paid through property taxes.

The program costs about {sw.heard[0].figure} a year either way. The warrant itself says the tax route "will likely require a Proposition 2 1/2 override in the future." Select Board: {sw.select_board}.
